name: Kettle Tea Making Robot Skills
description: Parametric skills for an electric-kettle tea making task with a UR5 + Robotiq gripper. Mirrors the cuboid_manipulation skill style: the robot controller is the `program_executor` ROS 2 node in ur5_curobo_control, and each skill maps to a program file under ur5_curobo_control/programs/, invoked via the load-then-execute sequence: (1) set ROS 2 parameters `program_file` and `program_args` on the executor node, (2) call service `/program_executor/load_program` (std_srvs/Trigger), (3) call service `/program_executor/execute_program` (std_srvs/Trigger). A single parametric `pick_and_place_items.prog` moves any key item from storage to the workspace using keyword args (`object=...`, `destination=...`); the tea bag and spoon may be dropped into the cup instead of the working area. Dedicated kettle programs pour water into the kettle, close the lid, and turn it on. The robot CANNOT open the kettle lid — the human does that to signal intent to make tea.

parameters.program_file: string — absolute path or basename of the .prog file under ur5_curobo_control/programs/

skills.name: Move to Named Position
skills.description: Move the robot to a specific named joint configuration or position (e.g. Home, safe, a storage or workspace pose).

name.description: The name of the position to move to

skills.name: Pick and Place Item
skills.description: One-shot pick-and-place of a key item from storage to a destination, transiting via the safe pose. Use the `item` keyword to select which object to move and `destination` to choose where to drop it. The tea bag and spoon may be dropped into the cup; all other items go to the working area. This skill has no fixed trigger step — once its preconditions hold, the decision LLM chooses when and what to deliver (e.g. fetching the remaining items while the kettle boils). The sugar container is intentionally excluded — there is no perception monitor for it, so the robot cannot confirm a move and the human is responsible for fetching it.

item.description: Item id to pick from storage; must match an object in initial_scene.json. Sugar is excluded (no perception monitor — human-handled).

destination.description: Named drop pose. Normally the item's own `<item>_workplace`; tea_bag and spoon may instead use `cup_workplace` to drop into the cup. Each item has its own workplace pose (items can't share a drop spot).

skills.name: Return Item to Storage
skills.description: Cleanup counterpart of pick_and_place_item: once the tea is prepared, take items the robot brought out back from the working area to storage, using the same parametric pick-and-place program with the poses reversed. Only items with a perception monitor are listed (milk_container, tea_bag, cup, biscuits) so the robot can confirm each return; the spoon and sugar are excluded (no perception) and are the human's responsibility. Triggers after the prepare_tea step completes; the BT returns one eligible item per tick as the robot frees up.

item.description: Item id to return to storage from the working area. Limited to perception-tracked items so the move can be verified.

destination.description: Named storage drop pose. Each item returns to its own `<item>_storage` pose.

skills.name: Bring Water Bottle
skills.description: Pick the water bottle from storage and bring it to the human in the working area. Only valid while the bottle's cap is CLOSED — if the cap is open the robot pours water directly instead (see pour_water_into_kettle). Uses the same parametric pick-and-place program with the water bottle as the object.

skills.name: Return Water Bottle to Storage
skills.description: Cleanup counterpart of bring_water_bottle: once the water has been poured into the kettle and the kettle has been switched on, the bottle is no longer needed, so the robot takes it from the working area back to storage. Uses the same parametric pick-and-place program with the bring_water_bottle poses reversed. The water bottle has a perception monitor (water_bottle_location), so the robot can confirm the return. Becomes eligible after the close_lid_and_turn_on step, letting the robot tidy up the bottle while the kettle boils.

skills.name: Pour Water into Kettle
skills.description: Pour water from the open water bottle into the open kettle. Requires the bottle cap to be open and the kettle lid to be open.

skills.name: Close Kettle Lid
skills.description: Close the kettle lid after water has been poured. The robot can close the lid (but cannot open it).

skills.name: Turn Kettle On
skills.description: Switch the kettle on to start boiling. The blue LED turns on while it heats and turns off when the water has boiled. Requires the lid to be closed and water in the kettle.

skills.name: Stop Program
skills.description: Halt the currently executing program immediately.

skills.name: Wait
skills.description: Wait for a specified duration or until the human signals readiness (e.g. while the kettle boils).
